requestedOutcome: Build the full LEGO software city in dependency order with reviewable evidence and no implicit authority.

constraints: executor declarations exist; confinement evidence is incomplete
snapshot/diff/rollback exist; common merge registry missing
human/machine views exist but are independently generated
requires a future exact one-use user authorization and receiver proof
external substrate/dependencies not selected or tested

cheapestHonestRoute: reuse current registries, journals, evidence tools, and intake tools
extract generic workflow/artifact organs only after compatibility tests
keep network/public gates disabled until separately authorized
proofBoundary: A block is not complete until its focused tests and phase exit gates pass. Passing tests do not promote or canonize it.
